headline: As of 2025-10-23, Amoxicillin has 4 fully approved applications across all dosage forms, 3 actively marketed, and 1 oral suspension shortage with Current status, which is a stale record.
markdown:
## Answer

As of 2025-10-23, Amoxicillin has 4 fully approved applications, and 3 of them are actively marketed (marketing status Prescription). These counts cover every Amoxicillin dosage form, not only oral suspension, so they are an upper bound for oral suspension. [E3]

1 Amoxicillin oral suspension shortage is in Current status: DS-2023-0142, Oral Suspension 250mg/5mL. Its last revision is old, so confirm it before quoting it. [E3]

## Detail

**Applications (all Amoxicillin dosage forms)**
- Total Amoxicillin applications: 6. Of these, 4 have full approval and 2 have Tentative Approval. [E3]
- Marketed (Prescription): Sandoz Inc (ANDA065355), Aurobindo Pharma Limited (ANDA078201) and Lupin Limited (ANDA091234). [E3]
- Approved but Discontinued: 1, held by Teva Pharmaceuticals USA Inc (ANDA065491). [E3]
- Tentative Approval, listed separately: Hikma Pharmaceuticals LLC (ANDA082345) and Cipla USA Inc (ANDA095678). [E3]
- The sponsors are application holders. They are not necessarily the companies that run the manufacturing sites. [E3]

**Shortages (oral suspension, latest revision per shortage)**
- DS-2023-0142, Oral Suspension 250mg/5mL, NDC 65162-0175-00: **Current**. It was first posted 2023-08-01 and last revised 2024-01-10. The reason category is Manufacturing Delay, and the related application is ANDA065355. [E3]
- Status history for that shortage: **Resolved** on 2023-11-15, then back to **Current** on 2024-01-10. [E3]
- DS-2022-0089, Oral Suspension 400mg/5mL: **Discontinued** as of 2023-01-20. The manufacturer has stopped or will stop producing it, and supply will not recover from that source. It is not Resolved and is not counted as Current. [E3]

## Interpretation applied

- **Approved:** The reading used is full approval only, which gives 4. The alternate also counts Tentative Approval, which gives 6 applications. Tentative approvals are not marketed. [E3]
- **Currently in shortage:** The reading used is Current status only, taking the latest revision per shortage. Resolved and Discontinued are kept separate. The alternate that adds Discontinued was not computed. [E3]
- **Actively marketed:** The reading used is marketing status Prescription. [E3]
- **Oral suspension:** The presentation filter matches "Oral Suspension%". The matching presentations are Oral Suspension 200mg/5mL, Oral Suspension 250mg/5mL, Oral Suspension 40-200mg/5mL, Oral Suspension 400-57mg/5mL and Oral Suspension 400mg/5mL. [E2]
- **Amoxicillin:** The reading used is the generic name Amoxicillin. Amoxicillin-Clavulanate is a separate generic and is excluded. [E1]

## Caveats

- Applications have no dosage-form field, so the application counts cannot be limited to oral suspension. They may overstate oral suspension supply. [E3]
- DS-2023-0142 has conflicting status records, Resolved and then Current. The latest, Current, is used. [E3]
- The Current status for DS-2023-0142 was last revised 2024-01-10. That is more than eighteen months before the as-of date, so it needs confirming. [E3]
- Amoxicillin-Clavulanate shortage records link to ANDA078201, whose active ingredient is Amoxicillin. That link looks wrong, so application facts for those records are unreliable. They are excluded here. [E3]

## Cannot be answered from this data

- How many approved or marketed applications are specifically for oral suspension. [E3]
- Whether DS-2023-0142 is still in shortage today. That needs confirming with Drug Shortage Staff. [E3]
